## Social Media Content Quality Gate

### How it works

This workflow manually checks social media content stored in Google Sheets before making any updates. It reads rows, validates the posts in a batch, and determines whether any new quality issues were found. If issues exist, it sends a Slack notification, then expands the prepared results and updates the corresponding sheet rows.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials for both the row retrieval and row update nodes.
- Select the correct spreadsheet, sheet, and row-matching/update columns in the Google Sheets nodes.
- Configure Slack credentials and choose the destination channel or user for issue notifications.
- Review the validation code to ensure it matches the sheet columns and quality rules used for the social media content.

### Customization

Adjust the validation logic, Slack message text, and Google Sheets update fields to match your content standards and approval workflow.

## Load and validate posts

Starts the workflow manually, retrieves social media content rows from Google Sheets, and performs the initial batch validation before any sheet changes are made.

## Check and notify issues

Evaluates whether validation found new issues and, when needed, sends a Slack message before continuing the workflow.

## Prepare and update rows

Combines the post-validation path, expands prepared update data into individual rows, and writes the results back to Google Sheets.
